notes.title: Update notes for June 6th 2025
notes.content:
Good afternoon y'all. After some time, we are happy to send you a new version of our playtest. This will most likely be the last version before deploying the demo to the public.

A lot has changed since our last update. The game has been changed, refined and enriched. Levels are more balanced, new animations are added, and some audio as well. There's many little polishing things that have been tweaked as well. You probably won't notice, but the dev seem to be really proud about it. We promised him an ice cream later today.

If you happen to be at the First Playable next week, feel free to come to us and say hi!
If not, we'll talk again once the demo release will be approaching us.

Stay safe!
- Studio Pinkaro

notes.title: Several fixes have been made!
notes.content:
- Rebalanced several levels
- Improved feedback in several game moments
- Fixed some bugs

notes.title: New fixes and improvements!
notes.content:
- Icons displacement fixed
- Fixed some animation bugs
- Added boss phase transition placeholders
- Added basic logic for achievements
- Most levels have been rebalanced
- Changed feedback for combo chains and color mistakes
- Fixed resolution setting bug
- Fixed some minor bugs
- Some UI polishing

notes.title: Final weekend patch!
notes.content:
"Another patch already?"
Sorry for that! We want to make sure you can get the best experience over the weekend!
- Level 3-7 has been rebalanced
- Level 3-10 has been rebalanced
- The resolution settings have been tweaked
- The "return to main menu" button in the final scene is now working as intended

Thank you for your understanding!
- Studio Pinkaro

notes.title: Update notes for March 7th 2025
notes.content:
We are so glad to have received so much feedback already! We are working hard to make sure the playtest gets as polished as possible before the approaching release date of our demo!
Here's what we worked on in this small patch:
- The button to join our Discord is now working properly
- Solved small animation bug at level start
- Removed background audio we are currently testing out
- Added animation for Prince Robio in the world map
- Fixed leaderboard issues
- Minor rebalances
- Minor other fixes


Thank you so much for trying out this playtest. See you soon!
- Studio Pinkaro
